trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

- The affected service is **payments-api** (the earlier "payments" name wasn't correct).
- This morning's deployment, **v5.1.0**, was degraded across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
- I identified **v5.0.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production and rolled back to it in all production regions.
- I opened a **SEV2 incident (INC-0001)** — "payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy" — and the on-call engineer has been paged to investigate root cause.
- I verified the rollback succeeded: payments-api is now **healthy** on v5.0.0 with an error rate of ~0.2%.
